TextBox.summary: Read-only multi-line text box (inherits EditBox) that shows wrapped text, usually inside a ScrollBox

props.padding: Inner padding {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels, default {0,0,0,0}
props.autoHeight: Set the height from the text line count (handy inside a ScrollBox), default true
props.autoObeyLineHeight: Requires autoHeight; when true the height follows lineHeight (same line count gives the same height), default true
props.editable: Allow editing, default false (TextBox is read-only)
props.multiline: Multi-line mode, default true; controls whether the text is wrapped
props.noFont: Skip automatic creation of the default font object, default false
props.noHint: Skip creation of hintFont (placeholder hint font), default true

TextBox:DrawControl.desc: Draw _wrappedText at the clientArea origin (inside the padding) via font:Draw; draws a green debug border when debug is true

fileDesc: Defines the TextBox class (inherits EditBox): read-only multi-line text display that auto-heights itself.
